facts.text: South Wales earned its name because early settlers in 1804 saw the green hills and fields that reminded them of the Welsh countryside.
The Town of Wales was officially created on April 15 1818 when New York’s legislature split the large Willink township into Aurora, Wales, and Holland.
In 1928 the South Wales Fire Company was founded, marking a milestone in organized community response as the area grew modestly.
The Gow School, a residential private school, is located in South Wales and has educated students from around the world since 1947.
WGRZ’s broadcast tower and in‑house weather radar are based in South Wales, giving the hamlet a key role in regional television coverage.
Emery Park spans 457 acres in South Wales and is managed by the Erie County Department of Parks, Recreation and Forestry.
